'''Igbi Freemo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] member of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he conducted business out of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nashal]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG:IF" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Igbi Freemo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Igbi Freemo provided two [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]] to players, but the second quest was bugged and could not be completed.<ref name="SWG:IF" /> He was therefore disabled on [[July 26]], [[2007]] as part of the [[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.8: July 26 2007|Chapter 6.8]] update.<ref name="Chapter 6.8">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67352&month=072007|text=Chapter 6.8: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
